comment: Literally the best professor EVER. She offers so much extra credit that I ended up with over 100 in the class. Lectures are super entertaining, and she is very transparent about what material will be on exams. She is always able to meet outside of class and gives wonderful feedback. I can't recommend Dr. Tait enough!!

Take any class with Dr Tait She makes complex topics very easy Her lectures intresting and fun
She does an amazing job at teaching contoversial topics in an educational unbiased factual way that everyone can respect Very accesible and will edit assingment drafts and paper for you
Dr.Tait is clearly an expert very inspiring and an amazing professor!

Dr. Tait is very accessible outside of class for help with assignments and exam preparation. I enjoyed her lectures, and she offers many opportunities for extra credit. Overall, she is an amazing professor.

Super relevant class and very easy. She offers so many extra credit opportunities that I ended with above 100. The lectures can be boring at times, but she does her best to be engaging and provides breaks.
This class is a joke. Dr. Tait is super nice and caring but sometimes her lectures can be long and boring. If you need an easy A take this class with her.

She's a really nice professor and gives feedback on writings. Tests are easy as long as you pay attention to lectures and the review session she does before the exam, which can get kind of boring. She cares about her students and wants everyone to succeed, class should be easy if you pay attention and read some of the readings she highlights.

Dr. Tait is amazing. She gave really clear and straightforward lectures and assignments are very manageable and actually taught me about health studies. She is extremely kind and helpful and always worked with me when I had issues with the class. Highly recommend

Dr. Tait is a really great professor who does a good job of presenting the large topic of health systems in bite-sized pieces. There are a lot of different components to grading, so you are able to demonstrate your understanding in many ways. She is intelligent, easy to talk to, and cares about the success of her students. Would highly recommend

Would highly recommend Public Health & Media. Course material primarily consisted of assigned articles and videos. We had pre and post-class quizzes, but they were easy and based on class discussions and opinions. The group project and final assignment were straightforward and graded fairly easily. Would highly recommend Dr. Tait.
Amazing class. Quizzes are harder than expected but the reflections and presentations are easy. Participation is helpful for your grade. Very kind professor and interesting topics.

Dr. Tait is a great teacher! Her class is exactly how a 100 level class should be. She has open notes test every week which she makes harder than the actual test. You have a summary paper every week which is easily manageable. Definitely take her class as an intro to Health Studies!

I cannot express how wonderful Dr. Tait is. She is beyond knowledgeable and passionate about her career and research, and really attempts to get to know each of her students. She assigns readings for every class but they are both digestive and interesting. She always brought an awesome energy to every class and motivated her students!

Dr. Tait's Health Policy class is one I would recommend to anyone interested in the healthcare field. Very little effort is required, just do the short article readings each week (or don't) and the class that week will be on a certain health policy topic. Her class is lecture-based and she will go over the important parts of the readings for you.
